newsitem.title: FRANCE: EMU irreversible, no new conditions - de Silguy.
newsitem.headline: EMU irreversible, no new conditions - de Silguy.

text.p: European Monetary Affairs Commissioner Yves Thibault de Silguy said on arrival at an OECD meeting here that European monetary union was irreversible and no new conditions would be imposed.

De Silguy declined to comment on the opposition Socialist party lead in the first round of a French parliamentary election on Sunday but said the European Commission worked with EU governments "whatever their colour".
"The single currency is an irreversible phenomenon," he told reporters. The (Maastricht) treaty will not be renegotiated, there will be no new conditions," he added.

France's Socialist party has said in its election campaign that it favours monetary union but would attach conditions including early entry for Italy and Spain and an "economic government as a counterweight to the future European central bank.
